rationale: The four-view massing is coherent enough to read in all views, but it does not yet satisfy the gymnasium contract. The form is dominated by a faceted, stair-like cascade rather than one clear long-span hall, so the dominant gesture is weak and the hierarchy is muddled. The top and front views show an irregular wedge with multiple planar breaks and a diagonal truncation, while the oblique views suggest overlapping stepped volumes instead of a unified enclosed hall. There is little visible public void or entry seam at the access edge, and the section/roof logic reads more like arbitrary terracing than daylight/span expression. Repair integrity is acceptable because the shape still appears manifold and not visibly self-colliding, but program appropriateness and section fit are poor for a gymnasium.
